title: suggestion: implement batching for uploads
symptom: AAPS always uploads data to nightscout as soon as it is available, which can eat through battery quickly when mobile data reception is poor.
fix: Use the existing 'Slow down uploads' setting in NSClient->Preferences->Advanced Settings, which delays 1 second between processing records to lower CPU stress and power usage.
evidence_quote: When slow is enabled NSClient is delaying for 1 second between processing records (I think this lowers stressing the phones CPU and as such its power usage)
